la:adv:vix.gloss: with difficulty, with effort; scarcely, hardly, barely
senses: with difficulty, with effort; scarcely, hardly, barely
la:adv:vix.html:
vix, adv.
etym. dub.; perh. from root vic- of vinco
,
with difficulty, with much ado, hardly, scarcely, barely.
In gen.: quid est, sine his cur vivere velimus? mihi vero cum his ipsis vix; his autem detractis ne vix quidem,: quae vix aut ne vix quidem adpareant,: ut vix aut omnino non posset ... infirmari sua lex,; cf.: profluens amnis aut vix aut nullo modo, conclusa autem aqua facile corrumpitur,: vix incedo inanis, ne, etc.,: vix sum compos animi,: vix me contineo, quin involem, etc.,: Thr. Hic sunt tres minae. Gn. Vix, : vix in ipsis tectis frigus vitatur,: ego teneo ab accusando vix me hercule: sed tamen teneo,: Gabinius collegit ipse se vix, sed collegit tamen,: iter angustum et difficile, vix quā singuli carri ducerentur,: brevi spatio interjecto, vix ut his rebus ... administrandis tempus daretur,; cf.: adeo, ut vix ulla possit causa reperiri, prooem. § 12: ex hominum milibus LX. vix ad D. sese redactos esse dixerunt,to scarcely five hundred,: carcer vix carcere dignus, Lucil. ap. Don. et saep.: ego vix teneor, quin accurram,: vix est, ut id obtineat,; so —
Strengthened,
By aegre: vix aegreque amatorculos invenimus,: vix et aegre,: vix et aegerrime,, p. 108, 40; v. aegre.—
By saltem: illud vix saltem praecipiendum videtur,.—
By repetition: corpus matri vix vixque remissum,.—
In partic., of time, hardly, scarcely.
Absol.: assum atque advenio Acherunte vix via alta atque ardua, Poët. ap. (Trag. Rel. p. 208 Rib.): ah, vix tandem sensi stolidus!: vix tandem legi litteras,; : contingat vix deinde mori,.—
With a foll. cum, and poet. also et, to denote the immediate succession of two events.
With cum: vix agmen novissimum extra munitiones processerat, cum Galli, etc.,: vix erat hoc plane imperatum, cum illum ... videres,: vix ea fatus erat, geminae cum forte columbae ... caelo venere volantes,; .—
With et: vix primos inopina quies laxaverat artus, Et superincumbens ... liquidas projecit in undas Praecipitem,; so, vix ... et,; ; cf.: vix ... que,.—
With ellipsis of cum or et: vix proram attigerat, rumpit Saturnia funem, ; : vix bene desieram, rettulit illa mihi,; ; so, vix bene,.—
Strengthened by dum, and usually written in one word, vixdum, hardly then, scarcely yet: Dolabella valde vituperabatur, quod tibi tam cito succederet, cum vixdum triginta dies in Syriā fuisses,: haec ego omnia vixdum etiam coetu nostro dimisso comperi,: (Hannibalem) vixdum puberem,: vixdum serio adnuere,: progressis vixdum quattuor milia passuum,; ; : puer vixdum libertatem, nedum dominationem modice laturus,: vixdum dimidium dixeram: intellexerat,: vixdum epistulam tuam legeram, cum, etc.,, A, 3.—So with et, ; ; .

la:verb:vixet.gloss: third-person singular pluperfect active subjunctive of vīvō
